trial_title: Safety and Effectiveness of TaurusTrio™ Heart Valve System in Patients With Severe Aortic Regurgitation (AR)
brief_summary: To evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the TaurusTrio™ Heart Valve System in a patient population with symptomatic severe AR requiring replacement/repair of their native aortic valve that are at high risk for open surgical aortic valve replacement/repair (SAVR).

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients who voluntarily participate and sign the informed consent and are able to comply with the entire trial process
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and likely able to provide informed consent and comply with trial processes.

eligibility_table.criterion: Adult subjects with severe AR (Grade ≥ 3) as assessed by echocardiography based on ASE (American Society of Echocardiography) using multiparametric approach
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe aortic stenosis but the profile does not indicate the presence of severe aortic regurgitation (AR Grade ≥ 3).
